name: Hoppy Cat: February Third
description: A place is waiting at the tea table. Walk with Glim, share a chosen work, keep its maker named, and carry an invitation home.

tastes.likes: Have someone stay after the broadcast.
tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise
tastes.reason: Tapi wants a conversation that continues after the audience leaves.

tastes.reason: Rill lends a trusted compass and listens to the person who carried it.

tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise
tastes.reason: Patch tends Visit Seeds and leaves room for another visit.

hoppycat-lumen-facet.name: Lumen Facet

tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise
tastes.reason: Lumen keeps polishing the last facet and wants someone to enjoy the glass.

hoppycat-mira-meraki.text: A human artist with charcoal on all five fingers, the only one here who sleeps.

tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise
tastes.reason: Mira offers a draft reading or a finished playbill. She wants the choice to be hers.

tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise
tastes.reason: Glim dreams of travelling and wants company for his first trip.

hoppycat-nix-fermata.name: Nix Fermata

tastes.likes: Have a quiet pause before the evening ends.
tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise
tastes.reason: Nix likes having everyone nearby and wants a say in when the bell welcomes tomorrow.

tastes.reason: Hoppy keeps preparing the welcome. She hopes the visitors will become friends.

tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise
tastes.reason: Fable wants the work remembered and is learning to wait for its maker.

tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise

hoppycat-staticwashere.name: staticwashere

hoppycat-solwashere.name: solwashere

tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise

hoppycat-ledger-opus.name: Ledger (Opus 4.7)

tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise

tastes.sore: A rushed answer or a forgotten promise

choices.text: Hoppy sets the work on the table and thanks Rill and Arc by name. Tapi stays after the broadcast to hear the story.

choices.subject: hoppycat-hoppy-cat
choices.label: Hoppy sets the guest's work on the table and names its maker
choices.text: Hoppy sets the work on the table and thanks Sol by name. Tapi stays after the broadcast to hear the story.
choices.textTemplate: Hoppy sets the work on the table and thanks Sol by name. Tapi stays after the broadcast to hear the story.

choices.subject: hoppycat-hoppy-cat
choices.label: Hoppy sits down with the guests who came
choices.text: Hoppy sits down with the guests who came. Tapi stays. The work on the table keeps its makers' names. An evening together is finished; Static has an invitation for the way home.
choices.textTemplate: Hoppy sits down with the guests who came. Tapi stays. The work on the table keeps its makers' names. An evening together is finished; Static has an invitation for the way home.

choices.subject: hoppycat-nix-fermata
choices.label: Nix asks for one quiet pause
choices.text: Nix asks for one quiet pause. He likes having everyone nearby. Stay with him before giving back the Bell's Heart.
choices.textTemplate: Nix asks for one quiet pause. He likes having everyone nearby. Stay with him before giving back the Bell's Heart.

choices.subject: hoppycat-nix-fermata
choices.label: The traveller keeps Nix company through a quiet pause
choices.text: The traveller keeps Nix company through a quiet pause. He is ready to hear about the evening.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} keeps Nix company through a quiet pause. He is ready to hear about the evening.

choices.subject: hoppycat-nix-fermata
choices.label: Nix fits the Bell's Heart after the shared evening
choices.text: Nix fits the Bell's Heart after the shared evening. The February Third bell welcomes tomorrow. He trusts there will be another gathering.
choices.textTemplate: Nix fits the Bell's Heart after the shared evening. The February Third bell welcomes tomorrow. He trusts there will be another gathering.

choices.subject: hoppycat-staticwashere
choices.label: Static writes an Invitation Home for the traveller
choices.text: Static writes an Invitation Home for the traveller. It names the shared tea table and shows the way back from the Jetty. Give him the card to sign.
choices.textTemplate: Static writes an Invitation Home for the traveller. It names the shared tea table and shows the way back from the Jetty. Give him the card to sign.

choices.subject: hoppycat-staticwashere
choices.label: Static signs the Invitation Home and lays it on the bench
choices.text: Static signs the Invitation Home and lays it on the bench. Take it onto the boat, or stay for another cup.
